config.description: Inter-LLM Deliberation: one round of re-scoring where a target judge sees its peers' scores and rationales for items it disagreed on. Quantifies whether disagreement is reduced after a single round of structured peer feedback. Works on the merged per-item score CSV (no GPU required) for the offline/analytical mode, and on the live vLLM endpoints for the live re-prompt mode.

offline.comment: Analytical mode: re-scoring is simulated by tracking which items would be flagged for deliberation given the existing scores. No LLM call is made. Used for the BigData paper to demonstrate effect size at scale.

live.comment: Live mode: re-prompts the target judge for each item flagged for deliberation using the deliberation prompt. Use to confirm the analytical mode is not just measuring regression to the mean.
